ownership_decision.invariant: catalog owns search_documents and decides listability; ingest only supplies the enrichment and the vector through the injected claim and store functions.

boundary_decision.interaction: ingest reads the documents to embed and writes their vector through two catalog functions injected at the worker entrypoint, as it already does for pending enrichments.

domain_forces: When only the embedding call failed, the paid enrichment was thrown away and the document stayed pending, so every hourly backfill paid for the same enrichment again and recorded the cost against the workspace.
implementation_design.decision: Keep the enrichment as enriched without a vector; a second backfill step claims enriched documents without a vector, embeds their stored text, and writes the vector guarded by the claimed updated_at.
invariants_preserved: A document is listable only once enriched or once it has a vector.
A pending document is still re-enriched from its package; a re-enrichment request still sets a document back to pending.
rejected_alternatives: A new 'embedding' enrichment status: the status enum is part of the public skill detail contract, while 'enriched without a vector' was already a listable state.
implementation_design.counterfactual_check: Dropping the updated_at guard from the generated StoreMissingEmbedding query lets a vector land on a rewritten document and fails TestTheEmbeddingBackfillClaimsOnlyEnrichedDocumentsWithoutAVectorAndSkipsARewrittenOne.

record.statement: A search document is listable only once its enrichment is finished or it has an embedding a vector search can find. An enrichment whose embedding call failed is still stored as enriched, without a vector, so it is listable at once; the enrichment backfill later embeds that stored text without calling the enrichment model again, and stores the vector only if the document has not been rewritten since it was claimed.
examples: A pending document without a vector is not listable; the same document with a vector is.

The enrichment answers and the embedding call fails: the document is enriched and listable without a vector; the next backfill pass makes one embedding call and no enrichment call, and a vector computed before a re-import rewrote the document is dropped.

approvals.scope: Keep a paid enrichment when only its embedding failed; the backfill embeds it without re-enriching
